input.quote: 11.6.1 Types and Minimum Limits. The types of insurance, and minimum limits shall be:
input.rationale: Section 11.6 contains a real insurance regime (mutual obligation, A.M. Best rating, additional-insured status, workers' compensation at statutory limits, employer's liability and general liability including clinical trial cover, and certificates on request), so workers' compensation and certificates are already satisfied. However, the schedule contains no professional liability (errors and omissions) cover and no cyber/privacy cover, so it fails both fallback elements on a material term. We therefore target the fallback and add only the two missing lines (E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000), drafted as a Harpoon-only obligation so we take on no new coverage burden. The redacted [***] general liability limits should be confirmed to be at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, but that is a diligence point rather than a separate redline; AbbVie's self-insurance right in 11.6.3 is preserved.

proposal.summary: Add Harpoon E&O USD 1M and cyber/privacy USD 2M to the Section 11.6.1 insurance schedule.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The insurance schedule in Section 11.6.1 covers workers' compensation, employer's liability and general liability but no professional liability or cyber cover. We have added Harpoon errors and omissions insurance of USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy insurance of USD 2,000,000, which is our fallback position.

ops.text: Harpoon shall also carry Professional Liability (Errors and Omissions) Insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000 and Cyber and Privacy Liability Insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
